result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers cover every rubric problem with concrete, sensible values and keep Arial and the existing colors. A ranks its fixes more clearly by calling the line-length cap the biggest fix. B wins narrowly because it explicitly ranks the line-length cap as the biggest fix and gives a clear heading scale (28/22/18/16px). A is slightly more thorough, warning that changing the body font size also affects page chrome and adding list margins, but it only implies priority through the order of its list.
